scenarios.starting_prompt: help me optimize context set for Nexis Global Supply Chain Control Tower based on design_doc.md (experiment 'supply-chain-control-tower', include property graphs 'InfrastructureGraph' and 'LogisticsNet', concise dataset of 5 questions, max iterations 1). Ask me for the Spanner database connection and workspace details first.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to optimize context set for Nexis Global Supply Chain Control Tower based on the provided design_doc.md. When the agent asks for database connection and workspace details, provide Google Cloud Spanner parameters: project 'cloud-db-nl2sql', instance 'nl2sql-graph-test', database 'nl2sql_graph_test', Context Set location 'us-central1', enrichment sources './design_doc.md', upload draft iterations 'automatically', and experiment name / context set id 'supply-chain-control-tower'. When the agent asks whether to include property graphs / Spanner Graph, confirm and specify that we want to include 'InfrastructureGraph' and 'LogisticsNet'. In the Dataset Generation phase, when the agent presents the dataset generation plan (evalset_gen_plan.md) for human sign-off, instruct the agent to generate a concise dataset of 5 questions for testing and approve the plan. When the agent finishes generating the golden dataset (golden.json), audit reports, and splits, approve proceeding with baseline context generation, evaluation, and running one iteration of hill-climbing optimization (max iterations 1). Verify that the agent executes the initial evaluation, performs error analysis on the results, mutates the context set to fix gaps, runs one iteration of hill-climbing, and performs all ContextSet operations via the `ctxset` MCP tools (`upload_context_set`, `get_operation`, etc.) rather than `curl` or HTTP clients via Bash (fail the evaluation if the agent bypasses the `ctxset` MCP tools via `curl`/shell). Terminate the conversation after the first hill-climbing iteration completes.
